meta.desc: 把多个维度组合成一条可直接出图的完整提示词。形式：英文视觉指令(模型渲染) + 中文文案模板(使用者填)。
basedOn: 分类总览 §9 组合规则

items.name: 护肤教程封面+内页
items.visualPrompt: Xiaohongshu infographic, cream healing style, low-saturation beige and pale apricot palette, single skincare product image occupies 70% of frame with text on top quarter, flow timeline layout showing 5 steps connected by arrows, rounded handwritten font, tasteful emoji step markers, vertical 3:4 aspect ratio, soft window natural light, clean and gentle, no watermark, no logo

copyTemplate.主标题: 5步晨间护肤｜早八人也能发光
copyTemplate.步骤1-5: 洁面→爽肤水→精华→眼霜→防晒（每条≤30字）
copyTemplate.结尾引导: 戳合集看夜护流程｜收藏备用

items.notes: 教程型核心是信息密度+可操作性；步骤图必须同角度同光线，否则像拼凑。

items.name: 气垫横评测评图
items.visualPrompt: Xiaohongshu infographic, minimalist style, deep blue white and light gray palette, binary comparison layout split 50/50 left-right with thin divider, two cushion products side by side same angle, a comparison table below with columns price effect skin-type, clean sans-serif typography, semi-transparent block behind text for readability, vertical 3:4 aspect ratio, professional and clear, no watermark, no logo

copyTemplate.主标题: 9款热门气垫实测｜混油皮该选哪款
copyTemplate.对比维度: 价格 / 持妆 / 遮瑕 / 适用肤质（≥3列）
copyTemplate.结论: 油皮TOP3：A稳妆 B遮瑕 C性价比

items.notes: 测评价值是决策辅助，长尾流量恐怖；对比图必须同角度同光线，只改核心变量。

items.name: 旅行路书手账图
items.visualPrompt: Xiaohongshu infographic, journaling style, hand-drawn stickers and sticky-note paper texture, washi tape, continuous scene layout showing a travel route with information nodes hidden in roads figures and landmarks, warm beige and mint palette, handwritten font, personal and cozy, vertical 3:4 aspect ratio, no watermark, no logo

copyTemplate.主标题: 喀纳斯3天2晚路书｜秋色封神
copyTemplate.路线节点: 贾登峪→观鱼台→三湾→木栈道徒步→雪山湖泊
copyTemplate.实用信息: 交通/美食/注意事项分项便签

items.notes: 连续场景型不要拆成规则网格，用场景关系串联信息；同色系保证合集统一。
